Name: Gus Edit
Author: pipmimi
Description:
(Updated for 1.6)
To me it looks like Gus has his tongue out all the time!
I've edited him a little so now he can be a respectable saloon owner.

To install:
Unzip the folder,
Then simply drag and drop into: Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Characters
(Don't forget to make a back-up just incase you change your mind!)

If you like this edit check out my ones for Marnie and Pam - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2455]Marnie Edit[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3051/]Pam Edit[/url]
